After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for 30 minutes to protect it. You can wait 30 minutes and try again, or reset your password straight away using the "Forgot password" link, which sends a reset link to your registered e-mail address. The reset link is valid for 24 hours.

## Brand warranty

ShopNest Care extends the warranty on electronics priced ₹2,000 and above. It must be bought within 30 days of delivery of the product.

## Furniture
All furniture sold on ShopNest carries a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, such as broken joints, frames or drawer runners. The warranty starts on the delivery date. It does not cover normal wear and tear, fading or stains on upholstery, damage from moving the furniture yourself, or damage caused by moisture.

For furniture warranty claims, a technician visits within 3 business days of your claim to inspect the item. If the defect is confirmed, we repair the item or replace the faulty part free of charge.

Go to My Orders, select the item and tap Warranty claim. Upload clear photos of the defect and of the product label. Our team reviews the claim within 2 business days.

Electronics have a 10-day return window and are mainly covered by the brand warranty, with optional ShopNest Care. Home goods and apparel have a 30-day return window. See the Warranty on Electronics policy for details.

# Refunds
## When a refund is initiated
For returns, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes our quality check, which happens within 2 business days of the item reaching our warehouse. For prepaid orders that you cancel before they are shipped, the refund is initiated immediately. For damaged, defective or wrong items, the refund is initiated as soon as the pickup is completed.

You will receive an SMS and e-mail with the refund amount and a refund reference number. For card and net banking refunds this reference is the ARN (Acquirer Reference Number), which your bank can use to trace the credit.

Once a refund is initiated, the time it takes to reach you depends on how you paid:

|---|---|

| Gift card | within 24 hours, back to the same gift card |
| Cash on Delivery | ShopNest Wallet within 2 hours, or bank account via NEFT in 5–7 business days |

# Order Changes and Cancellation
## Refunds for cancelled orders
For prepaid orders cancelled before dispatch, the refund is initiated immediately. Refunds to UPI take 1–3 business days, net banking 3–5 business days and credit or debit cards 5–7 business days. The delivery address can be changed before the order is shipped, but only to another address with the same pincode. To deliver to a different pincode, cancel the order and place a new one. The phone number for delivery can be changed until the order is out for delivery.

Refund timelines for UPI are 1–3 business days, for net banking 3–5 business days and for cards 5–7 business days after the refund is initiated. context:
# Payment Methods
## Accepted payment methods
ShopNest accepts the following payment methods on orders delivered within India:

- UPI, using any UPI app, a UPI ID or a QR code
- Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express and Diners Club
- Net banking from more than 50 banks
- ShopNest Wallet balance
- ShopNest gift cards
- NestCoins (1 NestCoin = ₹1)
- EMI on credit cards, select debit cards and cardless EMI
- Cash on Delivery (COD)

All prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and include GST.

## UPI
UPI payments are confirmed instantly. The maximum amount per UPI transaction is set by your bank, usually ₹1,00,000. ShopNest Plus membership can be renewed automatically using UPI AutoPay.

## Cards
Saved cards are stored as secure tokens in line with RBI card-tokenisation rules. ShopNest never stores your full card number or your CVV. Every card payment is authenticated with an OTP or your bank's 3D Secure page. International cards are accepted, and are charged in Indian rupees; your bank may add a foreign-exchange fee.

# Payment Methods
## Combining payment methods
You can split a payment between ShopNest Wallet balance, gift cards and NestCoins, and one other payment method such as UPI or a card. You cannot split a payment between two cards or between a card and UPI.

## Failed payments
If money was debited but your order was not confirmed, the amount is reversed automatically. UPI debits are reversed within 48 hours. Card and net banking debits are reversed within 5–7 business days, depending on your bank. You do not need to contact us; you can place the order again at any time.

If a payment fails repeatedly, try another method or clear your browser cache. Do not share screenshots of card details with anyone claiming to help with a failed payment.

## Invoices
A GST invoice is generated for every order when it ships. Download it from My Orders > Order details > Download invoice. Business customers who need GST input tax credit must add their GSTIN before placing the order; see the ShopNest Business policy.

# Payment Methods
## Payment security
Important: ShopNest will never ask for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number over phone, e-mail, SMS or chat. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

## Need more help?
For more information about Cash on Delivery and EMI, see the COD and EMI policy. For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Account and Security
## Staying safe
Important: ShopNest will never ask for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number over phone, e-mail, SMS or chat. Our agents will never ask you to install a screen-sharing or remote-access app. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

Beware of fake ShopNest pages and messages offering prizes, refunds or jobs in exchange for a payment or your bank details. ShopNest never asks you to pay money to receive a refund.

## Unauthorised activity
If you see an order you did not place, or a change you did not make, report it within 24 hours through chat or by calling 1800-202-6378. We freeze the account within 1 hour of your report and complete the investigation within 7 business days. Any amount charged for a confirmed unauthorised order is refunded in full.

You can sign out of all devices at any time from My Account > Security > Sign out everywhere.

# Gift Cards
## Buying a gift card
ShopNest e-gift cards are available in any amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000, in multiples of ₹100. The gift card is sent by e-mail or SMS to the recipient within 15 minutes of payment, or on a date you choose when you schedule delivery.

Gift cards can be paid for with UPI, cards or net banking. They cannot be bought with another gift card, NestCoins, ShopNest Wallet balance, Cash on Delivery or EMI. Gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

## Validity
Each gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The validity cannot be extended. Any balance left after the expiry date is lost, so check your balance under My Account > Gift Cards.

## Using gift cards
You can use up to 5 gift cards on a single order. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method, such as UPI or a card, to pay the remaining amount. If the order costs less than the gift card balance, the rest stays on the card for future orders.

Gift cards can be used on any product sold on ShopNest, but not to buy other gift cards.

# ShopNest Business: Bulk and B2B Orders
## Who can use ShopNest Business
ShopNest Business is for companies, schools, offices and resellers that buy in quantity. Register a ShopNest Business account with your company name and GSTIN. Verification usually takes 1 business day.

## GST invoices
Every business order gets a GST invoice with your GSTIN, so you can claim input tax credit. Your GSTIN must be added before you place the order. It cannot be added to an invoice after the invoice has been generated.

## Bulk pricing
An order qualifies for bulk pricing if it has 10 or more units of a single item, or an order value of ₹50,000 or more. Request a quote from the Business dashboard or by e-mailing business@shopnest.example; we reply within 1 business day.

| Order value | Bulk discount |
|---|---|
| ₹50,000 – ₹1,99,999 | 3% |
| ₹2,00,000 – ₹9,99,999 | 5% |
| ₹10,00,000 and above | 7% |

Larger or recurring orders can get custom pricing from your account manager.

# Exchanges
## Which items can be exchanged
Apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size or colour of the same product within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges are free: there is no pickup fee and no delivery fee. The new size or colour must be available at the same price; if it costs more or less, please return the item and place a new order instead.

Each item can be exchanged only once. If the replacement size or colour does not fit either, you can still return it for a refund.

Electronics cannot be exchanged for a different model, brand or colour. If an electronics item is defective or damaged, it can be replaced with the same model within 10 days of delivery through the returns flow.

Home goods, including furniture, kitchenware, bedding and home decor, are not eligible for exchange. You can return them within 30 days of delivery and place a new order for the item you want.

# Gift Cards
## Refunds on orders paid with gift cards
If you cancel or return an order that you paid with a gift card, the amount is credited back to the same gift card within 24 hours. If the gift card has already expired, the amount is added to your ShopNest Wallet instead, where it never expires.

## Gift cards are non-refundable
